course_review/1.card_source: golfify (page card, re-fetched 2026-10-30) cross-checked with AllSquare Golf (metres, x1.0936) and OpenGolfAPI: all agree on every hole of every set except 16 Black (golfify 345, AllSquare/OpenGolfAPI 316) and Red 3/8 (OpenGolfAPI only). Card below uses 316 on 16 Black.

OSM boxes, 346/323 = card. Short dogleg par 4. Blue CHECK (aim): Driver -7 (a tie with 4-wood) finishes 305 out, about 18 yds short of the green in the unmapped apron/rough beside it, not a fairway miss off the tee; the Black page shows 4-wood with Driver as good. Acceptable go-for-the-green play; no fix.

Par 3, 146/125 = card (AllSquare 134 m = 147 yds). Black CHECK: Black and Blue share one long OSM box; the Black marker sits at the card length about 6 yds behind that box's back edge. Within the slack of a real back tee; yardage and target box are right. No fix.

Card conflict on Black: golfify 345 (the page card) vs AllSquare 289 m = 316 yds and OpenGolfAPI 316. The OSM hole way (mapper's back tee) is 309-312 yds. The page's Black tee is a lidar pad 52 yds behind the Blue box (337 yds), 33 yds from any OSM tee, sitting in a hollow 9 ft below the ground 50 yds ahead. Two cards + OSM say 316: fix Black to 316 with the tee on the hole line ~23 yds behind the Blue box. Medium confidence (no photo of a separate back box). Blue (295, on the OSM box) is OK.
Par 3, 243/219 = card, box on the green, 46 ft drop.
544/506 = card. Driver, bunkers right of landing visible.

course_review/1.summary: 16 of 18 holes OK as built (OSM maps a box per set on nearly every hole; measured = card within 1 yd). One fix: 16 Black yardage/tee (card conflict, medium confidence). CHECKs 4 (Blue aim) and 15 (Black tee) reviewed and accepted.
